name: GLUCOSED
source:
This is a game about a normal human being, you, that somehow managed to enter this overly sweet sugar world. So sweet it makes you sick, literally!

You got taken in by a sweet girl named Sucrose, and she's been taking care of you the last 3 years. Although you're not getting better. The so called "after effects" of the world affects your body a lot, and in Sucrose's words it's because your body is not used to this amount of sugar in the air. She promised to keep you alive, and so you have been able to survive by her help.

Today is a special day! That is because your other friend's from this world are coming over for a tea party, meaning that you get to finally talk to them after 2 years. You want to catch up with them, and maybe along the way you'll find out what's really wrong? As you do that though, make sure your brain doesn't rot to a sugary mess.

[From [url=https://sugarycloud.itch.io/glucosed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于一个普通人的游戏，你，不知何故设法进入了这个过于甜蜜的糖世界。如此甜蜜，简直让你恶心！

你被一个名叫蔗糖的可爱女孩收留了，她在过去的三年里一直照顾你。虽然你的情况并没有好转。世界所谓的“后遗症”对你的身体影响很大，用蔗糖的话来说，这是因为你的身体不习惯空气中这么多的糖分。她答应让你活下去，所以你在她的帮助下才得以生存。

今天是一个特别的日子！那是因为你的另一个来自这个世界的朋友要过来参加茶会，这意味着两年后你终于可以和他们交谈了。你想追上他们，也许一路上你会发现到底出了什么问题？不过，当你这样做时，请确保你的大脑不会腐烂成一团含糖的烂摊子。

[来自[url=https://sugarycloud.itch.io/glucosed]itch.io[/url]]
